Suppose that for every nonempty signed word w = gε1 i1 · · · g εq iq with εj ∈ {1, −1} and pairwise distinct indices i1, . . . , iq, R(w) = { aw, ε1 = 1, bw, ε1 = −1. (4.2) Then a = b.
